items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: He picked Dick Johnson to do the clarinet.

ctx.x: I was not aware of that.

Oh yeah. When that band was formed Artie Shaw formed it. He picked Dick Johnson to do the clarinet. He picked the arrangements, he rehearsed them. When that band was relatively new I remember at Disneyland, Disneyland had a program in the summer when they’d put two weeks of different bands. And I was down there one night and I went to hear them. And Artie Shaw was there watching it. And he refused to ever play. He never played again. But he is very interested in seeing that band. So to me they were the truest to…
you know they came back here for a dance, it was that same band. Went over in the gym, God the acoustics were so awful. I sat there and I couldn’t believe it. I’d forgotten how bad they were.
